title: Polaris claim photo options
brief: I'm a product manager at Polaris Insurance and I need a page that sets out three genuinely different ways to let customers submit claim photos, for the product leadership review on 2026-11-12, which will be projected in the room. Under "The problem": 7 in 10 of our 5200 monthly claims arrive with missing or unusable photos, and each one costs a handler about 25 minutes of follow-up. Under "The options", as a table with effort, running cost per month, risk and time to launch: A, build our own guided photo capture into the app, 14 engineer-months, 6000 dollars a month to run, risk that it slips past the 2027-02-01 renewals season, 5 months; B, buy a photo-capture service from Pixelvault, 3 engineer-months, 0.80 dollars per claim so about 4160 a month, risk of depending on one vendor and a data review that takes 6 weeks, 10 weeks to launch; C, send customers a link to a simple upload form, 1 engineer-month, 900 dollars a month, risk that photo quality barely improves, 4 weeks. Under "What we would undo": A, 14 engineer-months of work cannot be recovered; B, switching vendor needs a contract exit of 90 days; C, the form is thrown away at almost no loss. Under "Recommendation": start with C in 4 weeks to cut follow-ups now, run B in parallel for the busy season, and defer A. Highlight the recommendation.

edit.request: Option B now costs 0.65 dollars per claim, about 3380 a month, and the data review takes 3 weeks instead of 6.
